purpose: Exact regression gate reference for PLAN-V3. Gates diff BY TEST ID and fail on any NEW or CHANGED failure. A total-count comparison is NOT a valid gate: one pre-existing failure can vanish while a new one appears, leaving the total unchanged.
refresh_note: Regenerated 2026-07-22 for PLAN-V3 Gate 0. The 2026-07-16 baseline (@42642323) had drifted: 3 date/env-sensitive tests (pg-batch14 appointment availability is day-of-week-relative; pg-batch-tax-snapshot backfill amount; the 503-vs-403 requireFeature case) read as NEW on a later calendar day. Proven to be baseline drift, NOT a Wave 0 regression: the identical failures reproduce on pre-Wave-0 main under the same command and date. Source report is the fix/v3-wave0 full-suite run, which equals the post-merge main state (Wave 0 adds only passing tests). run.command and signature() are unchanged from the original artifact.

run.note: Gates MUST use this exact command. --no-file-parallelism is load-bearing: concurrent vitest processes produce hook-timeout failures that are environmental, not real, and would poison the diff in both directions.

gate_protocol: Re-run the exact command in run.command from backend/ cwd.
Build the same {id, signature} set from the fresh report.
FAIL if any id is failing that is not in failing_tests (NEW failure).
FAIL if any id in failing_tests is failing with a different signature (CHANGED failure).
A previously-failing id that now passes is an improvement, not a gate failure — but note it, and if it was fixed deliberately, regenerate this artifact.
